meta.title: GPS Heatmap Generator — Free Activity Heatmaps
meta.description: Create heatmaps from GPX, FIT, TCX, GeoJSON, KML or Google Timeline files to see your running, cycling and travel patterns. Free, in your browser.

intro: Create beautiful heatmaps from your GPS activities. Upload multiple files to see your running, cycling, and activity patterns visualized on a map.
saveIntro: Want this in your Dawarich account too? We'll import it during signup — no second upload needed.
privacy: Rendering happens in your browser. Nothing is uploaded unless you choose “Save to my Dawarich account.”

cards.title: What is a GPS Heatmap?
paragraphs: A GPS heatmap visualizes the density of your location data on a map. Areas you've visited more frequently appear brighter and more intense, creating a visual representation of your activity patterns over time.

items.body: **Google Timeline JSON** - Records.json and Semantic Location History files from Google Takeout
**Strava:** Settings > My Account > Download your data
**Garmin:** Copy .FIT files from device or use Garmin Connect export
**Apple Fitness:** Use third-party apps to export workouts as GPX
**Google Maps:** Use Google Takeout to export location history — Records.json and Semantic Location History files are directly supported

cards.title: Free Alternative to Strava Heatmap
paragraphs: Strava's heatmap feature requires a paid subscription. This free tool lets you create similar heatmaps from your exported data without any subscription or account required.

upload.formats: GPX, FIT, TCX, GeoJSON, KML, KMZ, Google Timeline JSON
